name: God's Eye View
note: Installed only by scripts/setup-gods-eye.mjs. Dependencies come from its package-lock.json (npm ci checks every package's integrity hash). HARMONY starts it on 127.0.0.1 only. To move to a newer version, update commit, archive, archiveBytes and archiveSha256 together after checking it. HARMONY's own changes are laid on top from overlays/gods-eye (core/gods-eye-overlay.ts) and must be remade for a new commit.
